reconstructionNotice: The steel tumbler and its lid are scene props, not products; the parts of the ivory blazer front and black knit they and the raised arms cover are conservatively reconstructed. Only one gold-tone hoop is visible; the pair is inferred. Hidden backs and soles are inferred. Brand, metal, fibre composition and retail identity are unknown.

deck.ko: 아이보리 라펠과 토프 와이드 팬츠의 부드러운 균형.
deck.en: Ivory lapels balance soft taupe wide trousers.
deck.de: Elfenbeinfarbene Revers gleichen weite taupefarbene Hosen aus.

intro.ko: 카페 앞에서 텀블러 뚜껑을 돌리다 어깨가 자연스럽게 틀어집니다.
intro.en: Outside a cafe, twisting a tumbler lid naturally turns the shoulders.
intro.de: Vor einem Café dreht das Öffnen des Becherdeckels die Schultern ganz natürlich.

body.ko: 아이보리 블레이저 안의 검정 니트가 밝은 라펠 사이 중심을 잡습니다. 길고 넓은 토프 바지는 짧은 재킷의 비율을 이어가고 검정 양말과 로퍼가 하체 끝을 정리합니다. 작은 숄더백은 옆에 붙어 두 손의 동작을 비워 줍니다. 작은 금색 링과 직광 플래시의 선명한 그림자가 차분한 옷에 표정을 더합니다.
body.en: Black knit holds the center between pale blazer lapels. Long taupe trousers continue the short jacket proportion, while black socks and loafers give a clear finish. A small shoulder bag rests against the side, leaving both hands free. Small gold-tone hoops and a crisp direct-flash shadow add expression to the quiet layers.
body.de: Schwarzer Strick gibt den hellen Blazerrevers eine klare Mitte. Lange taupefarbene Hosen führen die kurze Jackenproportion fort, schwarze Socken und Loafer schließen sie ab. Die kleine Schultertasche bleibt seitlich und lässt beide Hände frei. Kleine goldfarbene Creolen und ein scharfer Blitzschatten geben den ruhigen Lagen Ausdruck.

pull.en: A black center between pale lapels.
pull.de: Eine schwarze Mitte zwischen hellen Revers.

copy.pullQuoteEn: A black center between pale lapels.

tip.ko: 가방을 옆구리에 붙이고 앞 단추를 열어 니트의 세로 면이 보이게 하세요.
tip.en: Keep the bag against the side and leave the jacket open to show the vertical knit panel.
tip.de: Die Tasche seitlich am Körper halten und die Jacke für eine vertikale Strickfläche offen lassen.

description.ko: 노치드 라펠과 밝은 단추, 플랩 포켓, 긴소매의 짧은 재킷입니다.
description.en: Short jacket with notched lapels, pale button, flap pockets and long sleeves.
description.de: Kurze Jacke mit fallendem Revers, hellem Knopf, Klappentaschen und langen Ärmeln.

howToWear.ko: 검정 니트가 중앙에 보이도록 앞을 열고 어깨선을 편안하게 두세요.
howToWear.en: Leave open over the black knit and let the shoulders sit naturally.
howToWear.de: Offen über schwarzem Strick tragen und die Schulterlinie locker lassen.
